ads.headline: Service businesses need hyper-local targeting at micro-budgets now
actions: Set radius targeting to 3-5 miles max, test neighborhood-by-neighborhood with $5/day splits
Create service-specific audiences: plumbers get 'emergency repairs' intent, landscapers get 'seasonal maintenance'
A/B test ad copy mentioning '24-hour response' or 'same-day quotes' against generic service ads
ads.source: r/FacebookAds weekly discussions on local service ad efficiency

creative.headline: Instagram Reels are exploding — ride the wave NOW
actions: "I tested Meta ads for 50 plumbers this month. Here's what actually worked."

Video idea: Screen record a Meta ads dashboard showing 2-3 real results (blur client names). Open with the hook above. Show cost-per-lead, conversion rate, ROI comparison to Google. End with: "DM 'ADS' if you want the same setup." Why it works: Proof-based content + specificity + clear CTA. Reels are at peak engagement right now — testimonial + data combo is gold for service business owners.

Avoid generic motivational takes about "why ads matter." People are scrolling Reels for quick, actionable proof — not philosophy. Also avoid posting to Stories instead of Reels this week; Reels views are 100x higher in your niche right now.
creative.source: Google Trends spike on 'instagram reels views' (100/100) + absence of engagement on generic hook/creative terms; implies audience actively seeking video proof content on platform, not theoretical ad strategies

critic.headline: Most failing ads this week have no clear offer — just a service name
actions: Open your current ad — does it have a specific outcome and deadline, or just your service name?
If your CTA is 'Learn More' or 'Contact Us' — change it to 'Get a Free Quote' or similar action
Check your click-to-lead rate: if under 15%, your offer is the problem, not the audience
